correctness.rationale: The exact finite claim is reconstructed by two independent exhaustive traversal directions. The profile-pair route proves zero counts below total 13 and 288 at total 13; the union-first route independently generates all componentwise decompositions of every 13-voter union and returns the identical 288-pair set. The size split, candidate orbits, union count, union orbits, multiplicity histogram, and representative witness are all exact consequences of that verified set.

value.rationale: The theorem completely classifies the first possible tie-independent reinforcement boundary for a canonical voting rule. It adds pair counts, symmetry classes, distinct-union counts, and exact partition multiplicities to prior existence/minimality results, directly addressing the mathematically natural partition-structure question identified in recent work.
